name: Ground Chicken Tacos
description: Quick weeknight taco meat made with ground chicken and taco seasoning.

steps.text: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground chicken and sauté 5 minutes, breaking it up with the back of a wooden spoon.
Add the taco seasoning and stir to combine, cooking until the meat is fully cooked with no pink remaining.
Add the water and reduce to a simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve as taco meat with tortillas, shredded cheese, salsa, avocado, and other favorite toppings.

notes: Ground turkey or beef can substitute for chicken in equal amounts. The simmering step deglazes the pan and restores moisture to the meat.
